notes: Cliopatria has no Ndebele kingdom. Budget: four pages for a no-shape state (Mthwakazi, Mzilikazi, First Matabele War, Northern Ndebele people) plus the Rozvi page for the 1838 conquest. The Mthwakazi page gives no founding year ('Established' empty), so 1823 is the Mzilikazi page's reign start and departure from Nguniland; the 1823-25 location is the researcher's (Mpumalanga, confidence 1). Not on any opened page, so not entered: Vegkop (1836), the Zulu attack of 1837, the dates of Inyati and Bulawayo as capitals, Lobengula's accession (the Mthwakazi page gives 'only in 1870 after a period of serious civil war'), tribute from Mashonaland, the Moffat treaty (February 1888) and Rudd Concession (October 1888) as a protectorate (the page says a 'treaty of friendship'), the 1896-97 rising (Northern Ndebele page: March 1896 to October 1897, 'the First War of Independence'), and the Griqua lands taken in 1831. The Northern Ndebele page says Mzilikazi 'reigned from 1823' and the Mzilikazi page gives death 9 September (infobox) or 5 September (body) 1868. Counterparts needing dossiers: british-south-africa-company (BSAC rule 1889-1923) and then Southern Rhodesia; Voortrekkers are only a name (the South African Republic dossier starts 1852). Gazetteer: names resolve (place Pretoria, Rustenburg; admin1 Mpumalanga, Midlands; region Matabeleland, Transvaal).
